source: Actual Electron GUI + temporary deterministic ACP emulator; not real services

Plugin GUI install disable enable uninstall

MCP GUI Setup uses normalized fields and the camel-case submission
Plugin GUI repository confirmation and required reload are explicit
MCP GUI A B A navigation discards the previous form completion
Plugin unsaved exit preserves input on cancel and discards only after confirmation
MCP unsaved route change protects the draft
Provider Escape protects changed model fields and leaves only after discard
Credential draft is protected without serializing the key
Credential form clears fake input on kernel acceptance
Provider save refuses pending approval without config or PID changes
Provider native GUI saves isolated config and restarts one kernel
Provider stale revision refuses overwrite and preserves the form
